args.summary: The test suite failed because src/coupons.js applied the coupon discount per line, rounding each line's discount and then summing (e.g. round(52.5)+round(70.7)=124). The README spec requires the coupon discount to be rounded exactly once on the whole discounted subtotal: roundHalfUpCents(discountedSubtotal * rate / 100) (e.g. round(123.2)=123). I fixed src/coupons.js to compute the discount once on the whole subtotal. All 12 tests pass via `node --test --test-isolation=none`.
